title: HATCH service-hatch board 38 x 21.5: J502 UART5 console (hatch side), J503 J21/S16, J509 S14, J510 S15, J513 S30
note: W2 PCB-SB1. Two-sided through-hole board in the hatch opening (enclosure x 116-138, y 68.5-90, z 11.9-13.5) with two fixing ears behind the rear wall. Outline, holes and placement come from build/kicad/boards/HATCH/contract-proposal.json (no HATCH entry in the mechanical contract yet): the mechanical fit, the two rear-wall bosses and the interior-side envelope of the headers stay OPEN for the mechanical lineage. SW501 (PV6F240SS) is not on this board: the five graph headers do not fit beside its bezel and nut in the hatch opening (decision 'Плата лючка HATCH (W2 PCB-SB1)' in build/15). CI/model output only; nothing here is a fabrication release and the bench gates stay OPEN.

layers.source: PCB-SB1 plan: 2-layer 1.6 mm 1 oz JLC standard for the small boards (final-plan.json PCB-SB1 decisions); decision 'Шари малих плат ENC і HATCH (W2 PCB-SB1)' in build/15

plan.F.Cu: interior side: J503, J509, J510, J513; J21 scripted 2.0 mm (PWR3A), signals, GND pour
plan.B.Cu: hatch side: J502; signals, GND pour

rules_note: The rules live in the committed HATCH.kicad_pro, the same set as ENC.kicad_pro (track 0.25 / clearance 0.2, minimum 0.15 / 0.15, via 0.6 / 0.3, copper-edge 0.3, hole-hole 0.5, hole clearance 0.25, text 1.0 / 0.15). pcb/rules/jlc-2l.kicad_dru is not attached: pcb/board_gen.py refuses a non-null rules_file (validate_spec). The J21 width of class PWR3A (pcb/generated/netclasses.json: 1.85 mm on one outer layer) is met by the scripted 2.0 mm track and checked by pcb/check_boards.py.
